title: Google Engineer Charged With Insider Trading on Polymarket
title_zh: 谷歌工程师被指控在 Polymarket 进行内幕交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A Google software engineer was charged with insider trading on Polymarket, where he allegedly made more than $1 million betting on one of last year’s most popular Internet searches.Most Read from BloombergSingapore Hands Byju's Founder His First Ever Jail TermIr...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——一名谷歌软件工程师被指控在 Polymarket 进行内幕交易，据称他在去年最受欢迎的互联网搜索之一上投注了超过 100 万美元。彭博社的大多数读者在新加坡手上 Byju 的创始人首次入狱。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures drop following US strikes in Hormuz
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货因美国在霍尔木兹的罢工而下跌
summary: US stock futures edged up as a wave of tech earnings boosted confidence in the AI trade.
summary_zh: 随着一波科技财报提振了人们对人工智能行业的信心，美国股指期货小幅上涨。

title: Why Android takes a bigger hit than Apple from AI memory shortages
title_zh: 为什么 Android 因 AI 内存短缺而受到的打击比苹果更大
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to break down new data showing the steepest decline in smartphone sales on record, as soaring demand for AI memory chips reshapes the semiconductor market.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 共同探讨市场主导地位，详细分析了新数据，这些数据显示，随着人工智能存储芯片需求的飙升重塑了半导体市场，智能手机销量出现了有记录以来的最大跌幅。

title: Pentagon awards Microsoft $9.7 billion deal in bid to cut costs, end license sprawl
title_zh: 五角大楼授予微软 97 亿美元的交易，以削减成本，结束许可证蔓延
summary: WASHINGTON, May 27 (Reuters) - The Pentagon on Wednesday announced a ‌five-year, $9.69 billion agreement to consolidate ‌Microsoft and other enterprise software licenses scattered across ​the military services, the intelligence community, and the U.
summary_zh: 华盛顿，5 月 27 日（路透社）——五角大楼周三宣布了一项为期五年、价值 96.9 亿美元的协议，以整合微软和其他分散在军事部门、情报界和美国的企业软件许可证。

title: SK Hynix and Micron lead AI boom, join trillion-dollar club
title_zh: SK海力士、美光引领人工智能热潮，加入万亿美元俱乐部
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Host Josh Lipton on Market Domination to break down the day’s leading tech stories, including SK Hynix (000660.KS) joining the Trillion-dollar club and Micron Technology (MU) impressive growth in 2026.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 与主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 共同探讨市场统治，详细剖析了当天的领先科技故事，包括 SK 海力士 (000660.KS) 加入万亿美元俱乐部，以及美光科技 (MU) 在 2026 年实现令人印象深刻的增长。

title: HP tops revenue, profit estimates as AI PC and Windows 11 refresh boost demand
title_zh: AI PC 和 Windows 11 更新提振需求，惠普营收和利润超过预期
summary: HP beat analysts' estimates for second-quarter revenue and profit on Wednesday, helped by strong demand for AI-optimized personal computers, but warned ‌that rising memory costs would pressure margins.
summary_zh: 得益于对人工智能优化个人电脑的强劲需求，惠普周三对第二季度收入和利润的预期超出了分析师的预期，但警告称，内存成本上涨将给利润率带来压力。

title: Amazon is offering its AI shopping tools to retailers
title_zh: 亚马逊正在向零售商提供人工智能购物工具
summary: Market Domination Host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma track several of the day's top trending stories and stock moves, including how Amazon (AMZN) is licensing and selling its "Alexa for Shopping" AI tool to other retailers.
summary_zh: 市场主导主持人 Josh Lipton 和雅虎财经高级记者 Brooke DiPalma 追踪了当天的几个热门故事和股票走势，包括亚马逊 (AMZN) 如何向其他零售商授权和销售其“Alexa for Shopping”人工智能工具。
